description: Community-contributed public address tags (exchange, ransomware, sanctions, mixer, scam, and other categories) across multiple cryptocurrencies, maintained by the GraphSense project and outside contributors.
license_note: Confirmed via the GitHub API license field on the repo itself. Unlike Elliptic++, this dataset is openly redistributable -- the retrieved archive can be re-fetched by anyone from the same public URL.

schema_notes.format: One YAML file per pack under packs/*.yaml. Top-level fields (currency, category, label, actor, source, ...) are pack-wide defaults; each entry under `tags:` is at minimum {address: ...} and may override any of those fields per-tag.
schema_notes.currencies_indexed: Only BTC, ETH, and TRX tags are read into the local index -- see integrations/exchange_tags.py:_RELEVANT_NORMALIZERS. The corpus also carries EOS, LTC, and other chains CyberTrace has no entity type for; those rows are skipped at index-build time, not deleted from the archive.
schema_notes.categories_seen: exchange, ransomware, sanctions (OFAC), mixer/service, scam, miner, gambling, and others -- category is stored per-tag so any of them can surface, not only 'exchange'.

safety_boundary: A tag here is a THIRD PARTY's public claim (a contributed tagpack) that an address belongs to some category/entity -- not independently verified by CyberTrace and never proof of control. It must never be written as EXCHANGE_DEPOSIT or any other relationship automatically -- see cybertrace/integrations/exchange_tags.py and evidence.enrich_bitcoin's exchange_tag_* docstring. Only evidence.label_exchange, on an analyst's own say-so, may create that edge.
